title: ReflexPerpetual
tagline: Enables perpetual storage of data on filecoin network by maintaining atleast # amount of copies on the network
description: Currently this project is in smart contract stage and  contract is deployed on hyperspace testnet and it is in development stage,Basic flow is a user stores data by calling storeData function and contract incentivises storage provider
how_its_made:
This smart contract is written in solidity and uses Filecoin-solidity library contracts from Zondax and the main functions of the contract are storeData,
verifyData and runAuction
